g.text: Raw evaluation from Black's perspective · same vertical scale in every panel
Only exact cp is drawn. Bound, mate and no-score results are gaps; gaps are never connected.
Shading and dotted lines split each game's plies into mathematical thirds, not opening/middlegame/endgame.
E/B/M/N = exact / bound / mate / no-score. This supplement does not change formal metrics or adoption decisions.
